vulnerability_type: CWE-214 Invocation of Process Using Visible Sensitive Information
source: line 19: - GIT_TOKEN=${GIT_TOKEN:?err}（运行时必需密钥）与 line 26: git clone https://x-access-token:${GIT_TOKEN}@git.example.com/private/repo.git /workspace/src

fix_suggestion: 令牌不进命令行：改用 BuildKit/Compose secrets 挂载凭据文件，经 GIT_ASKPASS 从 fd/文件读取，或 git -c http.extraHeader='Authorization: Bearer …' 携带令牌；克隆后执行 git remote set-url 移除 URL 内嵌凭据
